description: This file defines the EntityConditionList class, which represents an ordered collection of entity condition objects joined by a specific operator, typically used for building complex query conditions in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityConditionList
classes.description: A final class extending EntityConditionListBase, representing a list of EntityCondition objects joined by an operator, with methods to access size, iterator, and accept visitors.

methods.name: EntityConditionList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the list of conditions and the operator used to join them.

methods.name: getConditionListSize
methods.description: Returns the number of conditions in the list.

methods.name: getConditionIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the condition list.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition list.
